workload: isolated synthetic local WAV playback, volume 0, six queued copies of one six-minute fixture; 20,000 seeded metadata-only fixture listings; MCP library search pages during playback

measurement.limitations: No Vite server is used or sampled for the embedded frontend. Each process-group RSS sums resident pages and can double-count shared memory; storage IO is not network traffic; short-lived children between polls may be missed.
